blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Oddly Satisfying Videos (OSVs) can evoke strong viewer responses through repetitive motion, visual tactility, and ASMR-like sounds despite containing few explicit semantic emotion cues. This makes OSVs a challenging setting for Video Emotion Analysis (VEA), since most existing methods focus on semantic video content and under-model the physical sensory dynamics that shape viewer responses. To support Oddly Satisfying Video Emotion Analysis (OSVEA), we construct the Oddly Satisfying Video Dataset (OSVD), comprising 12,000 annotated 5-second clips. Each clip provides viewer-emotion labels under video-only, audio-only, and audio-visual conditions, together with explanations grounded in visual and acoustic sensory evidence. Building on OSVD, we propose PI-MLLM, a psychophysics-inspired multimodal large language model that integrates Modality-Specific Dynamics Alignment (MSDA) and Coalition-Based Audio-Visual Attribution (CAVA). MSDA uses auxiliary prediction objectives to align modality representations with visual motion and acoustic energy-onset dynamics. CAVA evaluates emotion scores across modality coalitions and applies Shapley attribution to identify the dominant modality and determine whether visual and auditory evidence is synergistic or conflicting. Experiments show that PI-MLLM improves both viewer-side emotion prediction and sensory-grounded explanation quality, suggesting the value of physical sensory cues to video emotion analysis.
blocks.zh: 奇怪的是,Satisfying Videos(OSVs)可以通过重复运动、视觉触觉和类似ASMR的声音引起观众的强烈反应,尽管其中很少包含明确的语义情感提示。 这使得OSVs成为视频情感分析(VEA)的具有挑战性的设定,因为大多数现有方法都侧重于语义视频内容,以及塑造观众反应的外观感官动态模型. 为了支持奇异满足视频情感分析(OSVEA),我们构建奇异满足视频数据集(OSVD),包含1.2万个注解的5秒片段. 每段片段都提供唯视频,唯音频,和视听条件下的观众-情感标签,以及基于视觉和声感证据的解释. 在OSVD的基础上,我们提出PI-MLLM,这是一个心理物理学启发的多模式大语言模型,它融合了Modality-Special Dynamics Unitation(MSDA)和基于联盟的视听归属(CAVA). MSDA使用辅助预测目标,使模式表达方式与视觉运动和声学能量对接动态一致. CAVA评价跨模式联盟的情感分数,并应用Shapley归属来识别主导模式,并确定视觉证据和听觉证据是协同还是相互冲突. 实验显示,PI-MLLM既改善了观众侧情感预测,又提高了感官定位解释的质量,为视频情感分析提出了物理感官提示的价值.

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Understanding how multimedia content shapes human emotion is a central goal in affective computing ( Picard 1997 ; Zhao et al. 2019 ; Wang and Zhao 2022 ) . Research on video emotion understanding has primarily focused on recognizing emotions expressed by on-screen individuals. A complementary line of research instead predicts emotions elicited in viewers by treating the video itself as an affective stimulus ( Dhall et al. 2012 ; Bagher Zadeh et al. 2018 ; Jiang, Xu, and Xue 2014 ; Deng, Ananthram, and McKeown 2025 ; Guo et al. 2025 ) . This viewer-centered task, known as Video Emotion Analysis (VEA), is particularly challenging for Oddly Satisfying Videos (OSVs), whose repetitive movements, visual tactility, and ASMR-like sounds can evoke satisfaction or relaxation despite sparse facial, linguistic, and narrative emotion cues ( Nansen and Balanzategui 2022 ; Poerio et al. 2018 ) . Accordingly, Oddly Satisfying Video Emotion Analysis (OSVEA) requires models to move beyond recognizing objects, scenes, and events and capture how physical sensory dynamics shape the viewer’s affective experience ( Reber, Schwarz, and Winkielman 2004 ; Nansen and Balanzategui 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 了解多媒体内容如何塑造人类情感是情感计算的核心目标(Picard 1997; Zhao et al. 2019; 王和赵2022 ). 关于视频情感理解的研究主要侧重于识别屏幕上个人表达的情感. 相反,一个互补的研究线预测了通过将视频本身视为一种情感刺激而引发观众的情绪(Dhall等人,2012年;Bagher Zadeh等人,2018年;Jiang, 徐, 和薛 2014; 邓, 阿南特拉姆, 和 McKeown 2025; 郭等 2025 ). 这个以观众为中心的任务被称为视频情感分析(VEA),对于奇异的满足视频(OSV)尤其具有挑战性,尽管面部、语言和叙事情感提示稀少(Nansen和Balanzategui 2022;Poerio等人,2018年),其重复的动作、视觉敏捷度和类似ASMR的声音仍可引起满意或放松。 因此,奇异的满足视频情感分析(OSVEA)要求模型超越识别对象、场景和事件,并抓住物理感官动态如何塑造观众的情感体验(Reber, Schwarz, and Winkielman 2004; Nansen and Balanzategui 2022 ) 。

blocks.en: However, existing VEA is not well suited to sensory-driven affect modeling in terms of supervision, temporal representation, and multimodal attribution (Figure 1 ). Datasets such as EmoCause focus on semantic content and causes, leaving modality-specific sensory dynamics under-explored ( Huang et al. 2025 ) . Although StimuVAR uses optical-flow peaks for frame selection, it may miss the stable repetitive patterns central to OSVs ( Guo et al. 2025 ) . Likewise, joint-fusion methods such as eMotions obscure modality dominance and whether audio-visual cues reinforce or conflict with each other ( Wu et al. 2025 ) . Consequently, a model may recognize a cutting action and predict interest , yet fail to explain how predictable motion, rhythmic sounds, and their coordination elicit that response. OSVEA therefore requires modality-specific sensory supervision, dynamics-aware representations, and explicit audio-visual attribution.
blocks.zh: 然而,现有的VEA并不完全适合在监督、时间代表性和多式联运归属方面对感官驱动的影响模型(图1)。 Emo Cause等数据集注重语义内容和原因,使得模式特定感官动力学探索不足(Huang等人,2025年). 虽然StimuVAR使用光学流峰进行帧选择,但它可能错过了OSVs核心的稳定重复模式(Guo等人,2025年). 同样,诸如emotions等联合组合方法模糊了模式的主导地位,以及视听提示是加强还是相互冲突(Wu等人,2025年)。 因此,一个模型可能承认一种剪切动作并预测兴趣,但未能解释可预测的运动、节奏的声音及其协调如何引起这种反应。 因此,OSVEA需要特定模式的感官监督、动态感知表现和明确的视听归属。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Existing VEA methods rely on sensory-ungrounded semantic annotations and implicit multimodal fusion. Our approach addresses these limitations with psychophysics-aware sensory annotations and explicit multimodal modeling that preserves modality-specific dynamics and cross-modal relations for viewer-emotion reasoning.
blocks.zh: 图1:现有VEA方法依赖于感官无底语义说明和隐含的多式联运聚变. 我们的方法是用心理物理学-意识感知说明和明确的多式联运模式来解决这些局限性,这些模式保留了特定模式的动态和供观众-情绪推理使用的跨模式关系。

blocks.en: To address the lack of an OSVEA-specific dataset, we construct the Oddly Satisfying Video Dataset (OSVD), comprising 12,000 12{,}000 annotated 5 5 -second clips segmented and selected from 7,242 7{,}242 online OSV source videos. As illustrated in Figure 2 , the raw videos are segmented, semantically deduplicated, and filtered for resolution and audio completeness before annotation. Domain-specific visual and audio expert models then process the isolated streams independently: the visual expert annotates the scene, motion, and state change, while the audio expert annotates the sound character, temporal envelope, and spatial impression. A fusion expert reconciles the two reports to generate audio-visual annotations and explicitly records whether the sensory cues reinforce, conflict with or complement each other. Each clip is annotated under video-only, audio-only and audio-visual conditions using the 27 27 -class Cowen–Keltner taxonomy adopted by VCE ( Cowen and Keltner 2017 ; Mazeika et al. 2022 ) . Human annotations on a sampled subset are compared with the model-generated labels using Cohen’s κ \kappa to assess reliability.
blocks.zh: 为了解决缺少OSVEA特定数据集的问题,我们构建了奇异的满足视频数据集(OSVD),包含1.2万个12{,}000个注解的5-5秒剪辑片段,从7,242 7{,}242个在线OSV源视频中选取. 如图2所示,原始视频分解、分解和过滤,以便在注释前进行解析和音频完整性。 域特异性视觉和音频专家模型然后独立处理孤立的流:视觉专家对场景,运动和状态变化进行注释,而音频专家则对声音字符,时间信封,空间印象进行注释. 一位聚变专家调和了两份报告,以产生视听说明,并明确记录感官提示是加强、冲突还是互补。 每个片段都使用VCE采用的27个27级Cowen-Keltner分类法(Cowen和Keltner 2017;Mazeika等人,2022年),在只录影带,只录影带和视听条件下附加说明. 在样本子集上的人类说明与模型生成的标签相比较,

blocks.en: Building on OSVD, we propose PI-MLLM, a psychophysics-inspired MLLM framework composed of Modality-Specific Dynamics Alignment (MSDA) and Coalition-Based Audio-Visual Attribution (CAVA). Within MSDA, Visual Motion Dynamics (VMD) and Acoustic Energy-Onset Dynamics (AED) align visual and audio representations with signal-derived optical-flow, RMS-loudness, and onset-strength descriptors, encouraging the encoders to preserve sensory dynamics that semantic supervision may overlook. CAVA evaluates emotion scores under different modality coalitions and derives Shapley-style visual and auditory contributions and their interaction ( Shapley 1953 ) , allowing PI-MLLM to distinguish modality dominance, complementarity, and conflict. On OSVD, PI-MLLM achieves an emotion classification accuracy of 43.2 % 43.2\% and an explanation semantic similarity of 0.661 0.661 , outperforming the evaluated video-only and audio-visual MLLMs as well as the matched autoregressive fine-tuning baseline. Ablations further show that VMD and AED provide complementary gains and that coalition-based attribution yields additional improvements.
blocks.zh: 在OSVD的基础上,我们提出PI-MLLM,这是一个心理物理学启发的MLLM框架,由Modality-Special Dynamics Unitation(MSDA)和基于联盟的视听归属(CAVA)组成. 在MSDA范围内,视觉运动动态(VMD)和声学能量-Onset动态(AED)将视觉和音频表达方式与信号衍生光学流,RMS-loudness,以及震动强度描述符相配合,鼓励编码器保存语义监督可能忽略的感官动态. CAVA评价不同模式联盟下的情感分数,并获得Shapley风格的视觉和听觉贡献及其相互作用(Shapley 1953),使得PI-MLLM能够区分模式主导,互补,冲突. 在OSVD上,PI-MLLM的情感分类精度达到43.2% 43.2\%,解释语义相似度达到0.661 0.661,优于评价的唯视频和视听MLLM以及匹配的自递微调基线. 差异还表明,VMD和AED可提供互补收益,基于联盟的归属可带来更多改进。

blocks.en: The main contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce OSVD, to our knowledge the first dedicated dataset for OSVEA with fine-grained viewer-side emotion labels and detailed physical sensory-grounded explanations across modalities. • We propose PI-MLLM, a psychophysics-inspired MLLM framework for OSVEA that introduces MSDA to align modality representations with non-semantic visual and acoustic dynamics and CAVA to quantify modality contributions and audio-visual interactions. • Extensive experiments on OSVD demonstrate the effectiveness of PI-MLLM, with comparisons against state-of-the-art methods validating its superior performance.

blocks.en: Related Work
blocks.zh: 有关工作

blocks.en: Video Emotion Analysis Dataset
blocks.zh: 视频情感分析数据集

blocks.en:
Video emotion analysis dataset targets the emotion triggered in viewers. It is distinguished from traditional multimodal sentiment analysis datasets like MOSI and MOSEI ( Zadeh et al. 2017 ; Bagher Zadeh et al. 2018 ) , which focus on the emotion expressed by the character appeared in the video. Originally, movies were an important material to analyze viewers’ emotion. MediaEval16 ( Dellandréa et al. 2016 ) and LIRIS-ACCEDE ( Baveye et al. 2015 ) were created to annotate audience feeling after watching specific movie clips. With the development of video platforms, videos are widespread in these platforms for people to share their emotion. YF-E6 ( Xu et al. 2016 ) and VE-8 ( Jiang, Xu, and Xue 2014 ) were established like mushrooms after rain. They both based on videos from popular video platforms YouTube and Flickr, but annotated based on different emotion classification policy. Recently, VEA datasets come to more detailed annotation. With VCE ( Mazeika et al. 2022 ) annotate the probability distribution of emotion evoked by the video, EmoCause ( Huang et al. 2025 ) annotate emotions with abundant explanations including video,audio, shot and content analysis. However, they still lack the annotation of some physical sensory features and the modality-specific emotion labels.
In this work, we introduce OSVD, a dataset with unimodal and cross-modal sensory annotation and detailed explanation of physical sensory features which also dominant to viewer’s emotion.
blocks.zh:
视频情感分析数据集针对观众引发的情绪. 它与传统的多模式情绪分析数据集如MOSI和MOSEI(Zadeh等人,2017年;Bagher Zadeh等人,2018年)有所区别,这些数据集专注于该角色在视频中出现的情感. 电影原本是分析观众情绪的重要材料。 MediaEval16 (Dellandréa et al. 2016)和LIRIS-ACCEDE(Baveye et al. 2015)都是在收看特定电影片段后,给观众以注意感的创作. 随着视频平台的发展,视频在这些平台中广为流传,供人们分享情感. YF-E6(徐等人2016年)和VE-8(江,徐,薛2014年)在雨后如蘑菇一样建立. 他们都基于YouTube和Flickr流行视频平台的视频,但根据不同的情感分类政策附加说明. 最近,VEA数据集有了更详细的注释. 在VCE(Mazeika等人,2022年)中, 然而,他们仍然缺乏对一些物理感官特征和模式特定情感标签的注释.
在这部作品中,我们引入了OSVD,这是一个带有单式和跨式感官注释的数据集,并详细解释了物理感官特征,这些特征对观众的情感也占主导地位.

blocks.en: Video Emotion Analysis Methods
blocks.zh: 视频情感分析方法

blocks.en:
The goal of VEA is to extract the relevant features to bridge the gap between the video content and the triggered emotion. Early studies on VEA mainly center on designing hand-crafted features to represent emotion. For example, Acar et al. utilized Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients to capture speech features relevant to viewer’s emotion ( Acar, Hopfgartner, and Albayrak 2017 ) . However, the correlation between the simple feature and triggered emotion is hard to be modeled. With the emergence of various VEA dataset, methods begun to focus on the multi-modal information fusion. Representative works like TAM ( Pan, Wang, and Fang 2022 ) designed a cross-temporal multimodal fusion module that applies attention-based fusion to different modalities within and across video segments in order to capture the cross-modal feature central to emotion analysis. However, the fusion process may lack intuitive explanation and thus affecting the credibility of the results. Recent work begun to treat external information as additional cues for emotion analysis. For example, LCAffect ( Deng, Ananthram, and McKeown 2025 ) utilize Danmaku as an auxiliary modality for emotion analysis. EmoDETective ( Huang et al. 2025 ) utilize detailed annotation of audio visual content and shot description to improve emotion analysis explainability. However, these methods may lack relative information in many situations.
Motivated by predictive-coding and processing-fluency accounts, we use optical-flow dynamics as a descriptor of visual motion predictability relevant to affective responses ( Friston 2012 ; Reber, Schwarz, and Winkielman 2004 ) .
blocks.zh:
VEA的目标是提取相关特性,以弥合视频内容与触发情感之间的差距. 关于VEA的早期研究主要集中于设计手绘的特征来代表情感. 例如,Acar et al. 使用 Mel-频率cepstral系数捕捉与观众情绪相关的语音特征(Acar,Hopfgartner,和Albayrak 2017). 然而,简单的特征与触发的情感之间的关联性很难被模型化. 随着各种VEA数据集的出现,方法开始专注于多式信息聚合. 代表性作品如TAM(Pan,Wang,Fang 2022 )设计了一个跨时态的多模式聚变模块,将基于注意力的聚变应用于视频段内部和跨视频段的不同模式,以捕捉跨模式特征对情感分析的核心. 然而,聚变过程可能缺乏直观的解释,从而影响结果的可信度. 最近的工作开始将外部信息作为情感分析的额外提示。 例如,LCAfect(邓、Ananthram和McKeown 2025)利用Danmaku作为情绪分析的辅助模式。 EmoDETective (Huang等人,2025年)利用音频视觉内容的详细注释和镜头描述来提高情感分析的解释性. 然而,这些方法在许多情况下可能缺乏相对信息。
在预测编码和处理流流账户的推动下,我们利用光学流动作为描述与亲切反应相关的视觉运动可预测性的标志(Friston 2012;Reber, Schwarz, and Winkielman 2004 ).

blocks.en: OSVD Construction
blocks.zh: OSVD 服务器 建筑业

blocks.en: To support OSVEA, we construct the Oddly Satisfying Video Dataset (OSVD), with 12,000 12{,}000 annotated 5 5 -second clips segmented and selected from 7,242 7{,}242 online short-form OSV source videos. As shown in Table 1 , existing VEA datasets typically annotate only one viewing condition and, at most, provide semantic explanations. OSVD instead provides viewer-emotion labels under audio, visual, and audio-visual conditions, together with both semantic and physical sensory explanations. Figure 2 summarizes its construction and annotation pipeline.
blocks.zh: 为了支持OSVEA,我们构建了奇异的满足视频数据集(OSVD),从7,242 7{,}242 在线短式OSV源视频中分出并选择了12,000 12{,}000 注释 5 5 - 秒片段. 如表1所示,现有的VEA数据集通常只标注一个查看条件,最多提供语义解释. OSVD则在音频,视觉和视听条件下提供观众-情感标签,同时提供语义和物理感官解释. 图2总结了它的建造和注解管道。

blocks.en: Table 1: Comparison between OSVD and representative VEA datasets. Emotion-label columns indicate whether annotations are provided under audio-only (A), video-only (V), and audio-visual (AV) viewing conditions. Emotion explanations are divided into semantic descriptions and physical sensory descriptions.
blocks.zh: 表1:OSVD与有代表性的VEA数据集的比较. 情感标签栏表示是否在音频(A),视频(V),以及视听(AV)的观看条件下提供说明. 情感解释分为语义描述和物理感知描述.

blocks.en: Figure 2: OSVD construction and annotation pipeline. Word-cloud-derived keywords guide data collection. Then segmented clips are semantically deduplicated, filtered for resolution, and checked for audio integrity. Visual annotations are structured as scene, motion, and state change, while audio annotations are structured as sound character, temporal envelope, and spatial impression. Finally, the modality-specific reports are fused into audio-visual annotations and evaluated against human judgments.
blocks.zh: 图2:OSVD建设和注解管道. Word-cloud衍生关键词指导数据收集. 然后片段片段被分解,过滤以解析,并检查音频完整性. 视觉说明的结构为场景,运动,和状态变化,而音频说明的结构为声音字符,时间信封,和空间印象. 最后,针对具体方式的报告已纳入视听说明,并根据人类判断进行评价。

blocks.en: We derive OSV-related search terms from a word cloud of representative descriptions and use them to retrieve raw videos from online video platforms. Each collected video is standardized and segmented into two non-overlapping 5 5 -second clips. OSVs are often organized around short repeated actions such as slicing, crushing, pouring, cleaning, or brushing ( Nansen and Balanzategui 2022 ; Gallagher 2016 ) ; a 5 5 -second clip usually captures one complete micro-action sufficient for emotion analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们从一个代表性描述的词云中得出了OSV相关搜索术语,并利用它们从在线视频平台获取原始视频. 所收集的每段视频都标准化,分成两个非重叠的5个5秒片段。 OSV常围绕切片,碾碎,倒灌,清洗,或刷刷等短暂的重复动作组织(南森和Balanzategui 2022;Gallagher 2016),5-5秒的剪辑通常能捕捉一个完整的微动作,足以进行情感分析.

blocks.en: We conduct several cleaning and filtering steps to ensure data quality. Firstly, we calculate pairwise semantic similarity between candidate videos and remove one video from each pair whose score exceeds 0.9 0.9 . Secondly, we discard videos whose orientation-normalized resolution is below 360 × 640 360\times 640 pixels. Thirdly, we inspect media-container and stream metadata, removing data with missing or corrupted audio.
blocks.zh: 我们采取了若干清理和过滤步骤,以确保数据质量。 首先,我们计算候选视频之间的对等语义相似性,从每对视频中删除一段,其得分超过0.90.9。 第二,我们丢弃其定向常态化分辨率低于360×640360\times640像素的视频. 第三,我们检查媒体-容器和流元数据,删除缺失或损坏音频的数据。

blocks.en: The visual and audio experts independently annotate each clip under isolated unimodal conditions. For the visual stream, scene describes the semantic setting and activity, motion captures time-varying movement patterns, and state change records observable transformations caused by the activity. With only video stream provided, Molmo2 ( Clark et al. 2026 ) uses these information to produce a video-only emotion label and explanation. For the audio stream, sound character describes timbral and spectral qualities, temporal envelope captures onset, evolution, and decay, and spatial impression represents perceived source proximity and sound-field extent. Given only this stream, Music Flamingo ( Ghosh et al. 2026 ) uses the three fields to produce an audio-only label and explanation. Both labels use the same fixed 27 27 -class viewer-emotion taxonomy. Claude Sonnet 4.6 ( Anthropic 2026 ) integrates the visual and auditory content reports to generate the audio-visual label and explanation, describing whether the two streams reinforce, conflict with, or complement each other.

blocks.en: Prediction-error accounts suggest that aesthetic pleasure can arise when prediction errors become progressively reduced as perceptual regularities are learned ( Friston 2012 ; Reber, Schwarz, and Winkielman 2004 ) . Taking a metal-cutting video as an example, after observing repeated cuts, viewers can infer the knife-motion pattern and anticipate subsequent changes. The resulting reduction in prediction error may contribute to the satisfying response. Motivated by this theory, we use mean optical-flow magnitude to represent frame-to-frame visual discrepancy and guide the model to better capture motion predictability. We attach a lightweight motion-regression head h m h_{m} to the visual encoder to predict mean optical-flow magnitude in order to help capture visual motion dynamics which are othervise neglected by previous semantic training strategy. Each clip is divided into T T temporal windows. At step t t , we compute the mean Farneback optical-flow magnitude g v , t ∈ ℝ g_{v,t}\in\mathbb{R} over consecutive frame pairs in the corresponding window ( Farnebäck 2003 ) . blocks.en: Experimental Settings

blocks.en: Dataset and protocol. The primary evaluation is on OSVD because it provides OSV-specific, modality-aware viewer-side labels and sensory-grounded explanations. We use a class-balanced OSVD test set to prevent majority emotions from dominating the metric. Emotion classification is evaluated using top-1 accuracy (ACC%) over the 27-class Cowen–Keltner taxonomy, while explanation quality is measured using Sentence-BERT-based Reason Similarity (RS) ( Reimers and Gurevych 2019 ) . We further report an out-of-distribution protocol on VCE and VE-8 after converting their labels to the OSVD taxonomy.
blocks.zh: 数据集与协议. 主要评价是在OSVD上,因为它提供了OSV特定,模式感知的查看器侧标签和感知基点解释. 我们使用一个阶级平衡的OSVD测试集来防止多数情绪占据这个指标. 情感分类使用27级Cowen-Keltner分类法的顶级-1精度(ACC%)来评价,而解释质量则使用基于Prime-BERT的理性相似性(RS)(Reimers和Gurevich 2019)来测量. 在将VCE和VE-8的标签转换为OSVD分类法之后,我们进一步报告关于VCE和VE-8的分布外协议.

blocks.en: Backbone and implementation. We instantiate the backbone with Qwen3-Omni ( Xu et al. 2025b ) and fine-tune it with LoRA ( Hu et al. 2022 ) ( r = 64 r{=}64 ).

blocks.en: Baselines. External baselines span four groups: video MLLMs (VideoLLaMA3 ( Zhang et al. 2025 ) , LLaVA-Video ( Zhang et al. 2024 ) , Qwen2.5-VL ( Bai et al. 2025 ) ), audio-visual MLLMs (Qwen2.5-Omni ( Xu et al. 2025a ) , video-SALMONN-2+ ( Tang et al. 2025 ) ), a closed commercial model (Claude Sonnet 4.6 ( Anthropic 2026 ) ) and video emotion analysis methods (Emotion-LLaMA ( Cheng et al. 2024 ) , StimuVAR ( Guo et al. 2025 ) , EmoDETective ( Huang et al. 2025 ) ). We additionally report Qwen3-Omni ( Xu et al. 2025b ) as the matched baseline for autoregressive(AR) fine-tuning and PI-MLLM.

blocks.en: Comparison with SOTA Methods
blocks.zh: 与SOTA的比较 方法

blocks.en: Table 3: Comparison with SOTA methods on OSVD. ACC (%) denotes 27 27 -class viewer-side emotion classification accuracy, and RS denotes semantic similarity between generated and reference explanations. Best per column in bold .
blocks.zh: 表3:与OSVD上的SOTA方法的比较. ACC(%)表示27个27级查看器-侧情感分类精度,RS表示生成和参考解释的语义相似. 每栏最好用粗体表示。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 3 , we report the classification accuracy and semantic similarity of different methods on OSVD. Overall, PI-MLLM achieves the best performance, with 43.2% accuracy and 0.661 semantic similarity.
blocks.zh: 如表3所示,我们报告OSVD上不同方法的分类精度和语义相似性. 总体而言,PI-MLLM的性能最好,精度43.2%,语义相似度0.661.

blocks.en: For vision-only models, Qwen2.5-VL and LLaVA-Video achieve the best results in accuracy (23.8%) and semantic similarity (0.487), respectively. PI-MLLM outperforms them by 19.4% and 0.174, showing the benefit of incorporating auditory information.
blocks.zh: 对于仅用于视觉的模型,Quen2.5-VL和LLaVA-Video分别在精度(23.8%)和语义相似度(0.487)上取得了最佳效果. PI-MLLM比它们表现优于19.4%和0.174,显示出纳入听觉信息的好处.

blocks.en: Audio-visual models remain limited, with video-SALMONN-2+ reaching 18.5% accuracy and Qwen2.5-Omni achieving 0.498 similarity. PI-MLLM still improves over them by 24.7% and 0.163, indicating that simple multimodal fusion is insufficient for OSVD.
blocks.zh: 视听模型仍然有限,视频-SALMONN-2+的精度达到18.5%,Qwen2.5-Omni实现0.498的相似性. PI-MLLM仍然比它们改进了24.7%和0.163,表明简单的多式联运聚变对于OSVD是不够的.

blocks.en: Video emotion analysis methods perform even worse, where Emotion-LLaMA and StimuVAR achieve 11.3% accuracy and 0.461 similarity, respectively. PI-MLLM surpasses them by 31.9% and 0.200, highlighting the difficulty of modeling OSVD with conventional approaches.
blocks.zh: 视频情感分析方法的表现更差,情感-LLaMA和StimuVAR分别实现11.3%的精度和0.461的相似性. PI-MLLM比它们多出31.9%和0.20,突出了使用常规方法模拟OSVD的困难.

blocks.en: Among closed-source baselines, Claude Sonnet 4.6 is the strongest, with 32.6% accuracy and 0.508 similarity. PI-MLLM still leads by 10.6% and 0.153.
blocks.zh: 在闭源基线中,克劳德·索内4.6是最强的,精度为32.6%,相似度为0.508. PI-MLLM仍然领先10.6%和0.153.

blocks.en: Overall, these results demonstrate that PI-MLLM effectively improves viewer emotion understanding in OSVD by leveraging modality-specific sensory dynamics and cross-modal interactions.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这些结果表明,PI-MLLM通过利用特定模式的感官动力学和跨模式互动,有效地提高了OSVD中的观众情感理解.

blocks.en: Module Ablation
blocks.zh: 模块读取

blocks.en: Table 4: Ablation study on OSVD. VMD and AED denote the visual motion dynamics and acoustic energy-onset dynamics auxiliary objectives inside MSDA, respectively. CLS, MC, and MI denote the coalition emotion classification loss, modality contribution loss, and modality interaction loss inside CAVA, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表4:关于OSVD的研究. VMD和AED分别表示MSDA内部的视觉运动动力学和声学能量对位动力学辅助目标. CLS,MC,和MI分别表示CAVA内部的联盟情感分类损失,模式贡献损失,模式互动损失.

blocks.en: Table 4 presents the contribution of each component in PI-MLLM. Following the Qwen3-Omni autoregressive baseline, we progressively introduce the proposed supervision objectives to evaluate their individual and combined effects.
blocks.zh: 表4列出了PI-MLLM中每个组成部分的贡献。 按照Qun3-Omni自动递减基准,我们逐步提出拟议的监督目标,以评估其个别和综合影响。

blocks.en: MSDA consistently improves performance. Introducing the visual motion dynamics objective alone increases the classification accuracy from 35.1% to 38.8%, while the acoustic energy-onset dynamics objective achieves a larger improvement of 39.7%. Combining both objectives further raises the classification accuracy to 42.1% and the semantic similarity to 0.655, demonstrating that visual motion and acoustic dynamics provide complementary sensory cues for viewer emotion understanding.
blocks.zh: MSDA不断提高性能. 仅引入视觉运动动力学目标,就将分类精度从35.1%提高到38.8%,而声学能量-振荡动力学目标则实现39.7%的较大改进. 结合这两个目标,进一步将分类精度提高到42.1%,语义相似度提高到0.655,表明视觉运动和声学动力学为观众情感理解提供了互补的感官提示.

blocks.en: We then evaluate the CAVA components. Based on the model equipped with both MSDA objectives, adding modality contribution supervision improves the classification accuracy from 42.1% to 42.7%. Introducing coalition emotion classification further increases the accuracy to 42.8%. Finally, incorporating modality interaction supervision yields the full PI-MLLM, achieving the best performance with 43.2% classification accuracy and 0.661 semantic similarity.
blocks.zh: 然后我们评估CAVA组件. 根据同时具备MSDA两个目标的模型,加上方式贡献监督,分类精度由42.1%提高到42.7%。 引入联盟情感分类进一步将精度提高到42.8%. 最后,纳入模式互动监督产生完整的PI-MLLM,以43.2%的分类精度和0.661的语义相似性达到最佳性能.

blocks.en: Overall, every proposed component consistently contributes to the final performance. The MSDA objectives enable the model to capture visual and auditory physical cues, while the CAVA objectives explicitly supervise coalition emotion prediction, modality contribution estimation, and cross-modal interaction modeling. Their complementary effects lead to the strongest overall performance on OSVD.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,每个拟议构成部分都始终有助于最终业绩。 MSDA目标使模型能够捕捉视觉和听觉物理提示,而CAVA目标则明确监督联盟情感预测,模式贡献估计,以及跨模式互动模型. 它们的补充作用导致OSVD上的整体表现最强.

blocks.en: Out-of-Distribution Generalization
blocks.zh: 分散式

blocks.en: Table 5: Out-of-distribution evaluation on VCE and VE-8. Both datasets are evaluated after re-annotation under the OSVD viewer-side 27 27 -class taxonomy and sensory-explanation protocol.
blocks.zh: 表5:关于VCE和VE-8.的分配外评价。 根据OSVD的查看器-侧面27 27级分类学和感知-解释协议,两个数据集在重新注释后进行评估.

blocks.en: Table 5 evaluates the out-of-distribution generalization ability of PI-MLLM on VCE and VE-8. Since neither dataset originally follows the OSVD annotation protocol, both are re-annotated using the same 27-class viewer-side emotion taxonomy and sensory-grounded explanation format to enable a fair comparison.
blocks.zh: 表5评价了VCE和VE-8上的PI-MLLM的分布外通用能力. 由于两个数据集最初都遵循OSVD注释协议,因此两者都使用相同的27级查看器侧情感分类法和感官定位解释格式重新附加说明,以便能够进行公平的比较.

blocks.en: As expected, all methods perform worse than on OSVD because of the domain shift in video content, emotion distributions, and annotation styles. Nevertheless, PI-MLLM demonstrates strong generalization across both datasets. On VCE, StimuVAR achieves the highest classification accuracy (34.3%), while PI-MLLM obtains a comparable classification accuracy of 33.8% and the highest semantic similarity score of 0.552. On VE-8, PI-MLLM achieves the best performance on both metrics, reaching 36.1% classification accuracy and 0.567 semantic similarity. Compared with the strongest competing methods, PI-MLLM improves the semantic similarity by 0.047 on VCE and improves the classification accuracy and semantic similarity on VE-8 by 0.6 percentage points and 0.049, respectively.
blocks.zh: 如所料,由于视频内容,情感发布,以及注释风格的域位变化,所有方法的性能都比OSVD更差. 尽管如此,PI-MLLM显示出两个数据集的强烈概括。 在VCE上,StimuVAR实现了最高分类精度(34.3%),而PI-MLM获得了33.8%的可比分类精度和0.552的最高语义相似度分. 在VE-8上,PI-MLLM在两个度量衡上都取得了最佳性能,达到36.1%的分类精度和0.567语义相似性. 与最强的竞争方法相比,PI-MLLM在VCE上将语义相似度提高0.047,在VE-8上的分类精度和语义相似度分别提高0.6个百分点和0.049.

blocks.en: Compared with the autoregressive fine-tuning baseline, PI-MLLM consistently improves both classification accuracy and semantic similarity on the two datasets, demonstrating that the proposed supervision generalizes beyond the OSVD training distribution. Overall, these results indicate that explicitly modeling modality-specific sensory dynamics together with modality contributions and interactions produces representations that transfer effectively to unseen video emotion datasets.
blocks.zh: 与自动回转微调基准相比,PI-MLLM在两个数据集上不断提高分类精度和语义相似性,表明拟议中的监督一般化于OSVD培训分布之外. 总的来说,这些结果表明,明确模拟特定模式的感官动态,以及模式的贡献和互动,会产生能有效转移到看不见的视频情感数据集的表示.

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en: This work investigates viewer emotion understanding in Oddly Satisfying Videos and highlights the importance of audio-visual sensory dynamics that are often overlooked by semantic-centered VEA methods. Through OSVD and PI-MLLM, we incorporated modality-aware emotion supervision, modality-specific dynamics alignment, and coalition-based audio-visual attribution into a unified framework for OSVEA. Experimental results demonstrate that modeling these factors improves both viewer-emotion prediction and sensory-grounded explanation, while the ablation studies confirm the complementary roles of MSDA and CAVA. Overall, our findings suggest that viewer-centered video emotion analysis should consider not only what a video depicts, but also how its sensory dynamics unfold and how individual modalities shape the resulting affective response.
blocks.zh: 这部作品在奇异的满足视频中调查了观众的情感理解,并凸显了视听感官动态的重要性,这些动态常被语义中心VEA方法忽略. 通过OSVD和PI-MLLM,我们把模式感知情感监督,模式特定动态协调,以及基于联盟的视听归属纳入OSVEA的统一框架. 实验结果表明,对这些因素进行模型化,既能改进查看器-情绪预测,又能改善感官-基于解释,而衰减研究则证实了MSDA和CAVA的互补作用. 总的来说,我们的调查结果表明,以观众为中心的视频情感分析不仅应考虑视频的描写,还应考虑视频的感官动态如何发展,以及个体模式如何塑造由此产生的感官反应.
